governance_binding.review_routing_rule: If independent review is required, publish a durable exact-bound GitHub request and leave routing to dispatcher/control-plane.

automation_policy.cutoff_rule: If same-race/provenance is not positively proven before cutoff, support increment stays zero; at or after cutoff no reconstruction, repair, or backfill is allowed and work pivots to the next portfolio event.
automation_policy.calendar_rule: While authoritative frozen calendar-block granularity is undefined, calendar dimensions remain UNKNOWN and full gate PASS is prohibited; granularity must not be invented.
automation_policy.queue_expansion_rule: Do not expand merely to create activity; expand only if the current queue is proven structurally insufficient.
automation_policy.identity_rule: Exact name then official registration; no fuzzy matching; UNKNOWN != 0.
